families.name: NQ panelboard (Class 1640)
families.overview: Current Square D 240 Vac / 48 Vdc lighting and appliance panelboard, 20 in. wide MH box (14 in. NQ14 variant), merchandised as ready-to-install (RTI) interiors plus field-installable kits (main breaker adapter kits NQMB*, sub-feed/feed-through lug kits, neutral kits, rail/deadfront extensions). Accepts QO plug-on and QOB bolt-on branch breakers; tandem breakers not allowed. Mains 100-600 A main lug or main breaker (QOB/QOB-VH back-fed, PowerPacT Q/H/J vertical, LA/LH, PowerPacT L).

main_ampacity.value: 100, 225, 400, 600 A merchandised (250 A main breaker interiors factory-assembled only)

branch_breakers.value: QO plug-on and QOB bolt-on (incl. -VH, -H, AFCI/GFI); 175/200 A QO only in single-phase 400/600 A interiors

families.name: NQOD panelboard (Class 1630)
families.overview: Predecessor of NQ; accepted QO plug-on and QOB bolt-on breakers. Sold 1987-2008. Schneider states NQ is the replacement but not a direct one: interior, box and trim must be replaced (e.g. NQOD30L400CU -> NQ30L4C plus new box/trim). All NQOD main breaker kits obsolete as of April 2016; branch connector kit SKNQOD225 existed for <=225 A interiors.

successor.value: NQ (not a direct replacement; replace interior, box and trim)

families.name: NQO / NQOB panelboard
families.overview: Early Square D three-phase lighting panelboards using Q1/Q1B plug-on and bolt-on breakers, developed late 1960s and obsoleted 1987 (replaced by NQOD). No kit data found in this batch.

families.name: NF panelboard (Class 1670)
families.overview: Square D 480Y/277 Vac (600Y/347 Vac max) lighting panelboard using E-frame bolt-on branch breakers (EDB/EGB/EJB, 15-125 A). Series 0 introduced 1995 replacing NEHB; Series E1 from October 2008. Merchandised RTI interiors with field kits: main breaker adapter kits (N150MH, N250MJ, N400M, N600MPPL), sub-feed/feed-through lugs, neutral kits, branch connector kits SKNF250/SKNF600. Maximum branch breaker pair combination 170 A.

voltage_rating.value: 600Y/347 Vac max (480Y/277 Vac with EDB/EGB/EJB US breakers)

branch_breakers.value: EDB, EGB, EJB (E-frame bolt-on); EDB/EGB/EJB EPD

families.name: NEHB panelboard
families.overview: Square D 480Y/277 V lighting panelboard using EH plug-on / EHB bolt-on breakers, manufactured 1983-1995 and replaced by NF. EH/EHB breakers reported no longer available. No NEHB kit part numbers were found in this batch.

families.name: I-Line circuit breaker panelboard (Class 2110)
families.overview: Square D 600 Vac / 250 Vdc distribution panelboard with plug-on I-Line breakers mounted on a bus-bar stack; breaker held by mounting bracket fingers in pan keyslots and a retaining screw into a 7/32 in. pan hole. Interior types HCJ/HCM (32 in. wide, 250 A max branch), HCP-SU (single row, 26 in.), HCP (42 in.), HCR-U (44 in.). Unused spaces must be closed with blank fillers (HNM1BL/HNM4BL) and blank extensions (HLW/HLN). Solid neutral, sub-feed lug and SE barrier kits are merchandised.

log: Method: Digest Section 9 (0100CT2401-SEC-09, 07/2026) downloaded from download.schneider-electric.com using p_Doc_Ref only with a browser User-Agent (www.se.com, product pages and se.com download URLs return 403; productinfo.se.com Digest Plus HTML pages fetched with curl and browser UA). Crawled all 40 Section 9 Digest Plus topics. Downloaded catalogs 1640CT0801 (NQ), 2110CT9701 (I-Line, served as zip), 1640BR1701, 998-21173700_GMA-US, I-Line manual 80043-309-20. Discovered instruction bulletins by HEAD-scanning p_Doc_Ref=80043-NNN-0S (600-999 and 0-599, suffixes 01-04): ~100 found, ~50 relevant downloaded to library and mined for kit contents, fasteners and torques. Schneider FAQ pages read via WebFetch (FA102748, FA124209, FA332061, FA123424, FA128003, FA121228) for legacy NQOD/NF timelines and connector kits; FA166748 (NEHB) blocked. 1670CT0801 (NF catalog) and 80043-401-03 (drip hood) returned 404. Container restarted mid-run; library files survived, JSON regenerated from generator scripts. Part count (~220) exceeds the 60-150 target because full OEM kit tables (NQ/NF lug, neutral, I-Line solid/expanded neutral) were entered rather than sampled. Page refs 'p. 9-N' = Digest PDF page N. Main gaps: legacy NQOD/NEHB/NQO kit numbers (only SKNQOD225 and the NQOD-era NQODBFMB20 found), component-level part numbers/dimensions for branch connectors, I-Line bus stack/mounting renewal parts, dimensions/materials generally not published.
